map.外包评估看什么？: What does outsourcing assessment look at?
map.资质（执照、保险、业绩）、报价合理性、应急预案与历史口碑，缺一不可。: Qualifications (licences, insurance, track record), price reasonableness, emergency plans and historical reputation, all of which matter.
map.外包出问题物业免责吗？: Is the property company exempt when outsourcing causes problems?
map.不，物业对外包服务向业主负总责，合同须约定追责与罚则。: No. The property company bears overall responsibility to owners for outsourced services, and the contract must specify recourse and penalties.
